title: Harden change-control release previews
summary: Harden change-control release previews by validating release version labels, making dry-run manifests include dev-placeholder packets for concrete release previews, and covering those edge cases with focused tooling tests.
reason: Release finalization uses the requested version as a directory segment, and release preparation dry-runs for a concrete version should preview the same completed changes that a non-dry-run preparation would include.
behavior_before: Version strings with path-like characters could reach release preparation/finalization paths, build_release_manifest.py reported absolute output paths by calling relative_to(REPO_ROOT), and prepare_release.py --dry-run for a concrete non-dev version generated a manifest that omitted complete packets still marked with dev placeholder version targets.
behavior_after: Release version labels are constrained to safe filename characters, manifest output reporting works for absolute paths outside the repository, and dry-run release preparation includes complete dev-placeholder packets when previewing a concrete release version.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe src/mediapipeline/tools/change_control/build_release_manifest.py --output "<temp>\change-control manifest path test.json" generated an absolute path-with-spaces output without a relative-path crash.

apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe src/mediapipeline/tools/change_control/prepare_release.py --version 1.0.0 --channel dev --dry-run included complete dev-placeholder packets in the preview manifest.
apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe src/mediapipeline/tools/change_control/finalize_release.py --version "..\outside" --channel dev --dry-run rejected the path-like version label as expected.

apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe src/mediapipeline/tools/change_control/prepare_release.py --version 0.1.0-dev --channel dev --dry-run regenerated the active change-control index, changelog, and manifest.
git diff --check for the scoped change-control files
rollback_plan: Revert the script validation and placeholder-preview changes, remove tests/tooling/test_change_control.py, regenerate summaries and change-control generated docs, and remove this packet if the hardening is not wanted.
notes: This is release-tooling-only hardening. It does not change media processing, queue launch, settings persistence, source/scratch/output movement, or pending-publish behavior.
